The page shows your account balance, estimated spend, token counts, and API request count over th"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"e last 24 hours (14 days in the daily view), rendered as a timeline bar chart similar to the officia"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"l DeepSeek platform usage page."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- 💰 **Balance card** — total balance with granted / topped-up split, labeled with the API-reported c"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"urrency code (CNY or USD), plus an availability badge, fetched from the official `GET /user/balance`"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" endpoint.
- 📊 **Metric cards** — 24h estimated spend (CNY), token counts (input / output split), an"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"d API request count.
- 📈 **Timeline chart** — hourly bars over the last 24 hours, or daily bars over"},{"id":"p6s5","text":" 14 days, toggled between cost, tokens, and request counts (hover for exact values).
- 🔄 **Live refr"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"esh** — balance refreshes every 60 s on the host; the page polls every 30 s and has a manual refresh"},{"id":"p6s7","text":" button.
- 🔑 **No extra key setup** — reuses the deployment's existing `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` credential"},{"id":"p6s8","text":" through the harness `credentials` service."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### Data notes"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Token counts are real** — they come from the `usage` chunk of every streaming model call (`Strea"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"mChunk` with `type: 'usage'`, `TokenUsage`), the same provider-reported numbers the harness itself u"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ses for session stats.
- **Cost is an estimate** — CNY is computed from DeepSeek's public list price"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"s (模型 & 价格) in the generated `PRICING` table (`src/index.js`), applied per model:
- cache hit input "},{"id":"p10s5","text":"→ `hit` price
- cache miss input → `miss` price
- output → `output` price
- cache write is not bille"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"d separately by DeepSeek and is excluded.
- since 2026-08-16 DeepSeek bills peak / off-peak: models "},{"id":"p10s7","text":"with `peak` / `offPeak` rates are priced by the request's UTC hour (windows in `peakHoursUtc`; 01:00"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC); the rest use their `flat` rate.
- **Persisted aggregation** — hourly bu"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"ckets keep 48 h, daily keep 14 d, persisted to `$DSH_HOME/storages/ds-api-usage.json` (writes deboun"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"ced to at most one per 60 s, flushed on plugin shutdown, fail-safe: a read/write error never breaks "},{"id":"p10s11","text":"accounting). The 14-day view therefore survives web-app restarts; delete the file to reset. The harn"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"ess separately keeps its own durable per-session token projection."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Via `dsh plugin add` (recommended, from GitHub or npm)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Install directly from this GitHub repository:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"or, once published to npm:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"`dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm in the profile directory and reconciles the
package into the profile's"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" bundle list (`dsh.profile.bundles`). The package's
`cordis.patch.yml` (declared via `dsh.bundle.pat"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ch` in `package.json`) then
inserts the plugin row into the host composition, and the `dsh.client`
d"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"eclaration makes the web shell load `client/bundle.js` as the settings page."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### As a dynamic plugin (dev / session-scoped)"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The original is a dynamic Cordis plugin, created per session with `cordis_define` / `cordis_run` (se"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"e the DeepSeek Harness docs). The `code.host` body is `src/index.js` minus the `module.exports` wrap"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"per; the `code.client` body is `client/index.js` minus the wrapper."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"> Note: the dynamic form uses the sandbox-private `harness.handle` / `host.call` channel (`client/in"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"dex.js`), while the static bundle form (`client/bundle.js`) talks to the host over the HTTP route `/"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"ds-api-usage/snapshot`. Keep both in sync when changing the protocol."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### As a composition plugin (persistent, manual)"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Add a row to the host composition (`cordis.patch.yml` of your profile):"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"or, without installing the package, by a relative path to this repository. The plugin is *host-plane"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"*: it reads the host `credentials`, `subprocess`, `timer`, and `webServer` services and registers th"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"e client settings page in the root-scoped `settings.section` slot, so it should live in the **host c"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"omposition**, not inside an agent preset."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### Requirements"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness with the DeepSeek LLM adapter configured (`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` credential resolvabl"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"e via the `credentials` service)
- `curl` available on the host for the balance endpoint
- A browser"},{"id":"p26s3","text":" client with the settings sidebar (for the UI)"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- Prices are auto-tracked: `.github/workflows/update-pricing.yml` (daily cron + manual dispatch) re-"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"parses the official pricing pages and opens a PR when the table changes; `npm run update:pricing` do"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"es the same locally (`--apply` writes the generated block in `src/index.js`). Edit the table only th"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"rough the script — the block between the `__PRICING_BEGIN__` / `__PRICING_END__` markers is generate"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"d.
- The client localizes through the harness `locale` service (namespace `settings.ds-api-usage`) a"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"nd follows the harness's active locale: dictionaries ship for the harness's `zh`/`en` ids plus a `pt"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"-BR` entry for future harness support (keys missing in the active locale fall back to `zh`)."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## CI / GitHub Actions"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"The repository ships two workflows — no secrets or API keys are required, and the only prerequisite "},{"id":"p31s2","text":"is GitHub Actions being enabled for the repository (default; check **Settings → Actions → General → "},{"id":"p31s3","text":"Allow all actions**):"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **`ci.yml`** — runs on every push and pull request: `npm run check` (syntax of both halves) and `n"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"pm test` (offline test suite with page fixtures).
- **`update-pricing.yml`** — re-parses the officia"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"l DeepSeek pricing pages every day (06:23 UTC cron) and on manual dispatch (**Actions → update-prici"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"ng → Run workflow**). When the table changes it opens a PR with the regenerated block (the workflow "},{"id":"p32s5","text":"declares `contents: write` and `pull-requests: write` on the default `GITHUB_TOKEN` — nothing to con"},{"id":"p32s6","text":"figure). If the docs page is restructured, the parser validation fails and the job fails loudly inst"},{"id":"p32s7","text":"ead of opening a bad PR."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
